title: Nice little washer
text:
Nice little washer. This pressure washer is a decent washer. It's small and works well. I wouldn't recommend it for large, dirty jobs but for washing a vehicle or siding it's fine. The pressure isn't high enough to really reach higher places. You have to be fairly close for it to really clean. For cement, I had to put the nozzle about 3 inches away to see it actually cleaning it. For jobs that aren't extremely stained or set in, I recommend this item for bigger jobs, I would step up to the stronger one. Small and lightweight is what won me over on this one.

If you have the problem I had with it not starting, it's because you have to use the wand to turn it on. It doesn't keep running, you have to press the button and push the handle in for the motor to kick on. This is why it appears DOA or will come on for a second and stop. Press they handle and you are in business!
